cobblemon.species.palafinhero.name: Palafin
cobblemon.species.palafinhero.desc1: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It’s also generating electricity.
cobblemon.species.palafinhero.desc2: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
cobblemon.species.poltchageist.name: Poltchageist
cobblemon.species.poltchageist.desc1: Trainers poltchageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its green tea.
cobblemon.species.poltchageist.desc2: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.
cobblemon.species.dipplin.name: Dipplin
cobblemon.species.dipplin.desc1: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it’s just an apple and nothing more.
cobblemon.species.dipplin.desc2: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
cobblemon.species.sinistcha.name: Sinistcha
cobblemon.species.sinistcha.desc1: Trainers poltchageist trusts will be allowed to experience its distinctive flavor and aroma firsthand by sampling just a tiny bit of its green tea.
cobblemon.species.sinistcha.desc2: These Pokémon multiply by creeping into teapots and pouring themselves into leftover tea.
cobblemon.species.pecharunt.name: Pecharunt
cobblemon.species.ogerpon.name: Ogerpon
cobblemon.species.ogerponteal.name: Ogerpon
cobblemon.species.ogerponfire.name: Ogerpon
cobblemon.species.ogerponwater.name: Ogerpon
cobblemon.species.ogerponrock.name: Ogerpon
cobblemon.species.shaymin-sky.desc: Upon taking in the scent of a particular rare flower, Shaymin is enveloped in light, and its tiny body transforms. I took a whiff of the flower myself, but alas, my body remained unchanged.
cobblemon.species.aerodactyl-mega.desc: When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.
cobblemon.species.alakazam-mega.desc: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.
cobblemon.species.beedrill-mega.desc: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.
cobblemon.species.blastoise-mega.desc: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.
cobblemon.species.charizard-megax.desc: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and creates intense blue flames.
cobblemon.species.charizard-megay.desc: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.
cobblemon.species.gengar-mega.desc: It tries to take the lives of anyone and everyone. It will even try to curse the Trainer who is its master!
cobblemon.species.gyarados-mega.desc: Mega Evolution also affects its brain, leaving no other function except its destructive instinct to burn everything to cinders.
cobblemon.species.kangaskhan-mega.desc: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.
cobblemon.species.mewtwo-megax.desc: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!
cobblemon.species.mewtwo-megay.desc: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.
cobblemon.species.pidgeot-mega.desc: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.
cobblemon.species.pinsir-mega.desc: The influence of Mega Evolution leaves it in a state of constant excitement. It pierces enemies with its two large horns before shredding them.
cobblemon.species.slowbro-mega.desc: All the energy from Mega Evolution poured into the Shellder on its tail, leaving Slowpoke to be swallowed whole.
cobblemon.species.venusaur-mega.desc: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.
cobblemon.species.ampharos-mega.desc: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.
cobblemon.species.heracross-mega.desc: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.
cobblemon.species.houndoom-mega.desc: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.
cobblemon.species.scizor-mega.desc: It stores the excess energy from Mega Evolution, so after a long time passes, its body starts to melt.
cobblemon.species.tyranitar-mega.desc: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.
cobblemon.species.steelix-mega.desc: The iron it ingested with the soil it swallowed transformed its body and made it harder than diamonds.
cobblemon.species.sceptile-mega.desc: The leaves growing on Sceptile’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile and it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
cobblemon.species.blaziken-mega.desc: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
cobblemon.species.swampert-mega.desc: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
cobblemon.species.rayquaza-mega.desc: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
cobblemon.species.medicham-mega.desc: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
cobblemon.species.latios-mega.desc: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
cobblemon.species.latias-mega.desc: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
cobblemon.species.gardevoir-mega.desc: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
cobblemon.species.camerupt-mega.desc: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years or whenever it becomes really angry.
cobblemon.species.altaria-mega.desc: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you’re in a dream.
cobblemon.species.aggron-mega.desc: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don’t take it lightly.
cobblemon.species.gallade-mega.desc: When trying to protect someone, it extends its elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.
cobblemon.species.abomasnow-mega.desc: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.
cobblemon.species.audino-mega.desc: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.
cobblemon.species.diancie-mega.desc: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
cobblemon.species.absol-mega.desc: It converts the energy from Mega Evolution into an intimidating aura. Fainthearted people expire from shock at the sight of it.
cobblemon.species.banette-mega.desc: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.
cobblemon.species.glalie-mega.desc: The excess energy from Mega Evolution spilled over from its mouth, breaking its jaw. It spews endless blizzards.
cobblemon.species.manectric-mega.desc: Mega Evolution fills its body with a tremendous amount of electricity, but it's too much for Manectric to fully control.
cobblemon.species.mawile-mega.desc: It has an extremely vicious disposition. It grips prey in its two sets of jaws and tears them apart with raw power.
cobblemon.species.metagross-mega.desc: Mega Evolution stimulated its brain. It emerged as a ruthless Pokémon that will clutch at any means of ensuring its victories.
cobblemon.species.sableye-mega.desc: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, the gemstone on its chest expands, rips through its skin, and falls out.
cobblemon.species.salamence-mega.desc: The stress of its two proud wings becoming misshapen and stuck together because of strong energy makes it go on a rampage.
cobblemon.species.sharpedo-mega.desc: The spines sprouting from its head are transformed fangs. If they're injured or broken off, the spines will regenerate countless times.
cobblemon.species.garchomp-mega.desc: Excess energy melted its arms and wings, transforming them into giant scythes.
cobblemon.species.lopunny-mega.desc: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.
cobblemon.species.lucario-mega.desc: Bathed in explosive energy, its combative instincts have awakened. For its enemies, it has no mercy whatsoever.

cobblemon.pokedex.minior-meteor.desc: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
cobblemon.pokedex.minior.desc: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.

cobblemon.species.deoxys-attack.desc: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise. It can fool enemies by altering its appearance.
cobblemon.species.deoxys-defense.desc: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.
cobblemon.species.deoxys-speed.desc: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.
cobblemon.species.hoopa-unbound.desc: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
cobblemon.species.rotom-heat.desc: A form in which Rotom lurks within a strange cauldron. The cauldron's origin is unknown. A bothersome Pokémon, causing trouble with the flames it spits.
cobblemon.species.rotom-wash.desc: A form in which Rotom lurks within an odd bureau. The bureau's purpose is unknown. A bothersome Pokémon, causing trouble by splashing cold water everywhere.
cobblemon.species.rotom-frost.desc: A form in which Rotom lurks within a bizarre cupboard. The cupboard's composition is unknown. A bothersome Pokémon, causing trouble by frosting everything over.
cobblemon.species.rotom-fan.desc: A form in which Rotom lurks within a mysterious contraption. The contraption's purpose is unknown. A bothersome Pokémon, causing trouble by stirring up powerful winds.
cobblemon.species.rotom-mow.desc: A form in which Rotom lurks within a misshapen wheelbarrow. The wheelbarrow's mechanisms are bizarre. It's a bothersome Pokémon, causing trouble by mowing down grass and trees.
cobblemon.species.necrozma-duskmane.desc: Necrozma has attached itself to Solgaleo. It siphons away its host's limitless energy, exploiting that energy to fuel a rampage.
cobblemon.species.necrozma-dawnwings.des: When Necrozma latches on to Lunala, it becomes vicious, seeing enemies everywhere it looks. It will burn the world with lasers.
cobblemon.species.calyrex-ice.desc: It's said that this Pokémon once moved a large forest—and all the Pokémon living there—to a new location overnight.
cobblemon.species.calyrex-shadow.desc: Legend says that by using its power to see all events from past to future, this Pokémon saved the creatures of a forest from a meteorite strike.
cobblemon.species.kyurem-white.desc: It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect that future.
cobblemon.species.kyurem-black.desc: The sameness of Zekrom's and Kyurem's genes allowed Kyurem to absorb Zekrom. Kyurem can now use the power of both electricity and ice.

cobblemon.species.barbaracle-mega.desc: It uses its many arms to toy with its opponents. This keeps the head extremely busy.
cobblemon.species.chandelure-mega.desc: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.
cobblemon.species.chesnaught-mega.desc: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.
cobblemon.species.clefable-mega.desc: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 32 feet around it.
cobblemon.species.delphox-mega.desc: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.
cobblemon.species.dragalge-mega.desc: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.
cobblemon.species.dragonite-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.
cobblemon.species.drampa-mega.desc: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.
cobblemon.species.eelektross-mega.desc: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.
cobblemon.species.emboar-mega.desc: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.
cobblemon.species.excadrill-mega.desc: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.
cobblemon.species.falinks-mega.desc: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.
cobblemon.species.feraligatr-mega.desc: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.
cobblemon.species.froslass-mega.desc: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.
cobblemon.species.greninja-mega.desc: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.
cobblemon.species.hawlucha-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.
cobblemon.species.malamar-mega.desc: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others—and to control them.
cobblemon.species.meganium-mega.desc: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.
cobblemon.species.pyroar-mega.desc: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.
cobblemon.species.scolipede-mega.desc: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.
cobblemon.species.scrafty-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.
cobblemon.species.skarmory-mega.desc: It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.
cobblemon.species.starmie-mega.desc: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.
cobblemon.species.victreebel-mega.desc: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it's not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.
cobblemon.species.floette-mega.desc: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.
cobblemon.species.zygarde-mega.desc: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.
cobblemon.species.raichu-megax.desc: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.
cobblemon.species.raichu-megay.desc: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.
cobblemon.species.chimecho-mega.desc: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.
cobblemon.species.baxcalibur-mega.desc: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.
cobblemon.species.zeraora-mega.desc: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.heatran-mega.desc: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.
cobblemon.species.darkrai-mega.desc: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.
cobblemon.species.absol-megaz.desc: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.
cobblemon.species.staraptor-mega.desc: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.
cobblemon.species.garchomp-megaz.desc: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.
cobblemon.species.lucario-megaz.desc: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.
cobblemon.species.golurk-mega.desc: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.
cobblemon.species.meowstic-f-mega.desc: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.
cobblemon.species.meowstic-m-mega.desc: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.
cobblemon.species.meowstic-mega.desc: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.
cobblemon.species.crabominable-mega.desc: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.
cobblemon.species.golisopod-mega.desc: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.
cobblemon.species.magearna-mega.desc: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.
cobblemon.species.magearna-original-mega: A mechanism to remove Magerna's limitations has lain secretly with Magerna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.
cobblemon.species.scovillain-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its "necktie" around to wallop its foes.
cobblemon.species.tatsugiri-curly-mega.d: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.
It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.
cobblemon.species.tatsugiri-stretchy-meg: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.
cobblemon.species.glimmora-mega.desc: Glimmora's petals—now larger and separated from its main body—rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.
cobblemon.move.nihillight.desc: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.
